name: Modal
summary: Dialog for a focused task or a confirmation. Blocks the rest of the page until the user makes a choice. The content sits in a native Figma slot.
use: Confirm an action you cannot undo.
A short task without leaving the context.
avoid: Long forms or a lot of content: use a separate page.
Messages without a choice: use Alert or Toast.
anatomy: Panel: featured icon (optional), title, supporting text, close button.
Footer with a Secondary action and a Primary action.
figmaProps: Destructive uses a red featured icon and Button destructive.
Leave it empty if there is no extra content.
behaviour: Native <dialog> with showModal: focus goes into the dialog and stays there.
Escape, the close button or a click on the backdrop closes the modal.
a11y: aria-labelledby points to the title, aria-describedby to the explanation.
After closing, focus goes back to the element that opened the modal.
content: Title as a question when you confirm: "Delete project?".
Buttons name the result: "Delete" and "Cancel", not "Yes" and "No".
do: Primary on the right, Secondary on the left in the footer.
dont: Open a modal from a modal.
Show important content only in a modal.
